regime_context: As of 2026-07-31, the US thematic detector shows broad eligible breadth (34/47 themes above trend-gate). Memory/HBM leads but is fading with zero breadth and low durability (0.44), while Cybersecurity and Energy display robust trend health (durability ≥0.75, high breadth) but Cybersecurity carries a crowding caution. Past leans have been poor (4/12 hits, directional accuracy 0.167), so any directional view must be low-conviction, conditional, and centered on the trend-gate’s validated drawdown/risk-control edge.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity’s trend is healthy (durability_bar 0.85, hurst ‘trend’, breadth 0.9) and passes the absolute-trend gate, which provides the only validated risk-reduction edge. Crowding (z=1.86) is a sizing caution, not a fade. This lean relies on the gate’s staying power to reduce drawdown, not on momentum alpha.
evidence: gate_helps=true — trend gate validated for risk control
theses.dissent: Crowding could indicate reflexive fragility; high durability does not preclude a sudden regime shift if market breadth narrows further.

falsifier.text: Cybersecurity’s breadth falls below 0.5 or the theme becomes ineligible (price breaks below absolute-trend threshold, e.g., 20-day low).

theses.subject: Energy (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Energy (EW) shows high durability (0.75), trend hurst, broad participation (0.86), and is not crowded. The absolute-trend gate helps avoid drawdown; staying with this established trend is a risk-control lean, not a return call.
theses.dissent: Energy is a macro-sensitive sector; a sharp rotation out of commodities or a macro shock (e.g., recession fears) could break the trend suddenly.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 50-day moving average or Energy’s durability_bar drops below 0.5.

theses.subject: Uranium & Nuclear Fuel
theses.thesis: Uranium & Nuclear Fuel is ineligible (below absolute-trend gate), has low durability (0.27) and poor breadth (0.2). The validated trend-gate drawdown edge supports avoiding such themes to reduce risk.
theses.dissent: A thematic catalyst (e.g., new nuclear policy) could spark a sharp reversal; the trend gate’s protection is about reducing drawdown, not predicting bottoms.

falsifier.text: URNM closes above a 20-day high and durability_bar rises above 0.5, signaling trend re-entry.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
